# mathedu · 수학자료실 (Mathematics Archive & Interactive Scaffolding Quizzes)

> 100% Free Open Educational Resource (OER) providing 3,400+ interactive GeoGebra visual proofs, PDF flipbooks, and elementary-to-CSAT step-by-step scaffolding math quizzes (Korean & English bilingual).

## Core Hubs
- [Main Hub (Interactive Exam Problem Finder)](https://min7014.github.io/mathedu/): Search and solve 119 official CSAT & KICE Mock Exam problems broken down into 5~8 elementary-to-advanced micro-steps.
- [Mathematics Archive (min7014.github.io)](https://min7014.github.io/): 3,400+ GeoGebra dynamic geometry applets, visual proof PDFs, AlgeoMath, and video lectures.
- [Standalone Offline Quiz Archive](https://min7014.github.io/mathedu/offline/index.html): Single-file offline HTML bundles that work 100% without internet access.
- [Live Classroom Dashboard](https://min7014.github.io/mathedu/dashboard.html): Instant QR code classroom launch & privacy-preserving (stu1~) live progress dashboard for teachers.
